text:
```yaml
name: PR Status Labeler

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Capture PR Data"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  label-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    steps:
      - name: Download PR Data Artifact
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          workflow: Capture PR Data
          run_id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          name: pr-data
          path: ./pr-data

      - name: Read PR Number
        id: get-pr
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(cat ./pr-data/pr_number.txt)
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Label PR
        uses: actions/labeler@v6
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ steps.get-pr.outputs.pr_number }}
          configuration-path: .github/labeler.yml
          sync-labels: true
```
